title: Pictures: my avatar and my hobbies
drivingQuestion: How can I critically partner with Artificial Intelligence to build a digital portfolio that authentically represents who I am to the world?

hints.structure: Use the formula: Subject:, Style:, Framing:, Lighting:.
hints.diff: Change at least one of Subject / Style / Framing / Lighting from your last prompt.
hints.vocab: Use a visual word from the bank for this image.
hints.prosRequired: Tell what you like about this image (at least 3 words).
hints.consRequired: Tell what you don't like or what could be improved (at least 3 words).
hints.bestReason: Say why this is your best image.
hints.worstReason: Say why this is your worst image.
hints.empty: Write a prompt - the text instructions you give to the image AI.
hints.accept: You can accept this field once you have at least 3 rated iterations, one best with a reason, and one worst with a reason.
hints.build: Your avatar is ready. Illustrate a hobby or ask your teacher to open Lesson 4.
hints.reasonRequired: Please explain in English why you want to change this image before generating a new one.
hints.reasonShort: Your reason needs at least 3 words. Tell the AI what is wrong with the image.
hints.publish: This image will go on your website. You can publish it now or keep improving it - you have up to 6 attempts total.
hints.noMore: No attempts left. Publish a version from your history.

fields.label: Avatar
fields.brief: Pick a prompt that builds a stylized image of YOU - not a photo. Use the formula Subject: ... Style: ... Framing: ... Lighting: ... . Generate at least 3 versions, rate each one (pros/cons), then pick your best and your worst with reasons.
fields.guidance: Check the details. Explain why one version fits your idea better than another.
